## Audience and purpose

Name the reader, decision/workflow supported, current gap, and source material.

## Scope and acceptance

List documents/links, required diagrams/examples, confirmed versus proposed decisions, open questions, reviewers, and consistency checks. Avoid claims of implementation, certification, perfect security, authoritative AI, or universal safe remediation.

## Validation

Check internal links, CloudOps terminology, EC2/S3/IAM scope, tenant isolation, credential and AI/remediation guardrails, accessibility, and project-memory impact.
